title: Julius Evola stayed with the SS to the end of the war

tellings.quote: No, he stayed with the SS till the end of the war. >> Oh interesting. He had access to their libraries and they let him have it.

plain: Peter Levenda, a writer on the occult and secret history, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Julius Evola, an Italian writer on mystical traditions, stayed with the SS, Nazi Germany's elite force, until the end of the Second World War. Levenda says the SS gave Evola access to their libraries, which would tie him closely to their hidden research.
